system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

Each time you blink, your Miraigan peers into the sea of possible futures. You are never certain what will happen, but you make certain to prevent the worst from every occurring.

When you roll initiative, and activate your Miraigan as part of it, it peers into 5 possible timelines. Roll the following dice and record each result separately: 1d20, 1d12, 1d8, 1d6, 1d4.

These results are called your Prophetic Pool for the duration of combat. You can use these results to replace die rolls made by creatures you can see, ally or hostile, when they roll a die or dice of the same size.

If a creature rolls multiple dice of the same size as part of the same effect, you can replace one of their die results with a recorded result from your Prophetic Pool as normal, but by spending 1 Foresight for every additional die you wish to replace with your Prophetic Pools result. Each replacement uses the same value.

Once you used your Prophetic Pool to replace a result, the used die size is exhausted until you next roll initiative.
